text:
Marco (CS): FYI customer 'GreenPillar' dropped a note in their kickoff — asks for a way to set per-account token budgets + webhook when budget hits 80%. They say it's blocking their pilot renewal. Link to convo: https://intercom.fake/conv/12345
Nadia (CS): ugh — renewal risk flagged. Can we triage this as a feature request + short-term workaround?
Ravi (PM): thanks Marco. Do we have details on expected traffic patterns and whether they need hard throttling vs just alerts? Any quote from the customer about impact?
Marco (CS): they said "we hit a surprise 3x token spike during onboarding tests, cost blew up, finance paused expansion" — they want both a quota + webhook.
Tess (Eng): short take: webhook + alerting is low effort (add a usage check + webhook trigger), hard enforcement (reject requests) touches runtime paths and billing logic — bigger. Rough estimate: alerting/webhook ~2 wks small-scope, enforcement ~4-6 wks with QA.
Ravi (PM): ok that aligns. Proposal: (1) quick-win webhook/alerting alpha in 2w, (2) product work for enforcement scoped as next sprint. Needs CS validation that alerting will unblock renewals.
Lina (Success): I'll ask the account exec to confirm whether an alert-only solution would be acceptable for the renewal window. Also we should draft an enablement note + one-pager for their finance team.
Nadia (CS): tagging @ravi — if customer accepts alerting alpha, can we ship a temporary policy doc we can attach to their next renewal conversation?
Ravi (PM): yes — I'll draft the product note. Also want customer logs/sample events to make sure 80% webhook won't spam them. Marco can you grab a sanitized sample?
Marco (CS): sending sanitized snippet in DM now.
product-bot: Created issue RED-5432: "per-account token budget + webhook alerting" — epic=RED-5400, priority=undecided. https://redwood.fake/issue/RED-5432
Tess (Eng): pinging infra — will need a small metric and a webhook delivery service. If we do alpha behind a feature flag for accounts, rollout is trivial.
Ravi (PM): Priority suggestion: P0 for this account (renewal risk), but P2 for platform roadmap unless more accounts ask.
Lina (Success): I'll add a renewal-risk tag on the customer record and cc finance. Also prepping a short FAQ for them.
Nadia (CS): action items: Marco -> sample logs + account acceptance, Lina -> renewal tag + exec confirm, Ravi -> draft product note, Tess -> feasibility + rough timeline. I'll update thread after exec call tomorrow at 10am PST. :thumbsup:
